description: Confirmed artifact surfaces emitted by Blacklight endpoint assessment or consumed by Blacklight session analysis.

assessment_coverage_states.explicitly_assessed: The exact path is a static endpoint-assessment target.
assessment_coverage_states.recursively_discovered: A bounded Scout or SessionSource traversal recognizes matching descendants.
assessment_coverage_states.intentionally_deferred: The artifact is cataloged for defensive visibility but is not currently emitted or parsed as an individual artifact.

blacklight.scout.PATH_TARGETS.note: Legacy evidence key retained for artifact compatibility; the JSON target catalog is authoritative.

blacklight.scout.endpoint_assessment.note: Native implementation of the count-only configuration, permission, and authentication assessment; managed parity is validated by the executable smoke tests.

blacklight.docs.artifact_collection.note: Operator collection guidance with upstream documentation references; deferred paths are not runtime findings.

detection_boundaries.match_policy: Match an exact root or a descendant separated by the platform path separator. Do not match lookalike siblings such as .codex-old.

artifacts.note: Documented Computer History Markdown storage; macOS directory metadata only. Nonempty CODEX_HOME overrides the default .codex root. Presence does not establish current enablement or successful access to file contents.
